annotations.text:
GymPulse — five product shots at iPhone 15 Pro size (393x852).
Colours, type ramp, radii and spacing are lifted from constants/theme.ts and constants/colors.ts in the repo, not approximated.
No painted iOS status bar: the real one renders over that inset, so it is left blank as the app does.

Sample data is one consistent intermediate lifter: Marcus Reid, level 13 (Dumbbell Knight), 12-day streak, 84 workouts.
The calendar, the 8-week chart and the weekly summary all agree with that story.
